May 17

25 He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal. 26 If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour. - John 12:25-26 (KJV)

Jesus was speaking of Himself, and His upcoming death, in this verse, but it also applies to us.  Jesus said this same thing in several other scriptures (Matthew 10:39, 16:25 & Mark 8:35).  This is speaking in a comparative sense, as Jesus also said in other scriptures (Matthew 10:37).  Anyone, who loves their life in this world more than they love God, can not expect to go to heaven.  The “life eternal” is not just living forever with the Lord, but is to know God and Jesus in an intimate way (John 17:3) now, in this life, and living with the Lord forever in eternity (Revelation 21:3).  Everyone will live forever, either on the New Earth with the Lord, or in the lake of fire along with the devil (Revelation 20:15).
